name: CRAP + duplication
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes, test-core]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 6
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.app != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.docs != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared/app/docs changes — guards green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.docs == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@2286a0c042b44434fe26d292bbce8d34f7ec662b # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.docs == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7.1.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      # Same scope gate as every other step here: on a skipped (app-only)
      # PR no dart SDK is set up, so an unconditional pub get dies with 127.
      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # gh-2072 (review thread 5): same scope gate as the pub get above —
      # the prewarm depends on exactly the same setup set (dart SDK +
      # package config) and must skip with it on app/docs-only PRs.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/sqlite3-native-assets-prewarm
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          pattern: coverage-shard-*
          path: coverage-shards

      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py -o coverage/lcov.info coverage-shards/*/lcov.info

      # gh-1738: activate is its own step so the Quality gates step below
      # can run for docs-only / app-zone-only PRs too — the similarity
      # corpus lives in docs/, prompts/, flutter_app/ and packages/, and
      # a diff confined there must reach the gate pre-merge (it routes
      # away from the CRAP ratchet, which needs the merged lcov).
      - name: Activate crap4dart (pinned)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.docs == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: pin bumped 0.2.1 → >=0.9.5 for the gate framework.
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh + the
          # duplication.sources key (native cross-module scan).
          # gh-1106: >=0.11.0 — Type-2 renamed-clone detection
          # (duplication.ignore_locals) + gate baselines; the
          # duplication gate config throws on older parsers (unknown
          # keys are a ConfigException).
          # Bounded (rework review): a floating >= would auto-adopt
          # 0.12.0+ with no repo change — bump the ceiling deliberately.
          # crap4dart#3/#4 (2026-10-15): >=0.14.2 — the broken_goldens
          # detector fixes (checkmark V, yellow-on-dark digits, hollow
          # boxes, solid glyph runs); the configs now rely on 0.14.2
          # behaviour (severity: error, old excludes dropped).
          # gh-1738: >=0.15.0 — the similarity gate (file-level
          # near-duplicates over md+dart), wired into crap4dart.yaml.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.15.0 <0.16.0"

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: 0.9.5+ carries the gate framework (broken_goldens
          # et al.); 0.2.1 knew only the CRAP ratchet. Both configs set
          # coverage.run_tests: false — the merged shard lcov above is the
          # coverage source; gates must not re-run the suite.
          # crap4dart activated (pinned) in the step above.
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Quality gates (broken goldens + Type-2 duplication, issue 1106)
        # gh-1738: + docs/app — the similarity gate scans the whole tree
        # (docs/, prompts/, flutter_app/, packages/ included); no project
        # pub get needed (global tool, config+file gates only).
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.docs == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --baseline

      # Issue #1234 rework: 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override (a
      # gates.loc.sources key is a ConfigException — caught here on
      # 019ede65), and the package config's sources drive the CRAP census
      # too, so test/ + example/ get the SAME loc gate from the companion
      # config (crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml) — the scope the retired shell
      # guards (gh-1232) scanned there. No baseline: nothing exceeds 2800
      # today, and the ceiling itself is the point.
      - name: Loc scope gate (test/ + example/, gh-1232 whole-tree ceiling)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc

      - name: Duplication guard (lib/ < 1%)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          npx --yes jscpd@5 --min-tokens 50 --min-lines 5 --reporters json \
            --output /tmp/jscpd-ci lib/ || true

          import json, sys

20:        separateDigestRole: _separateDigestRole,

23:      // hand-over alone — any other mode keeps the hard gate.
24:      if (softTriggered && mode != CompactionMode.merged) {

27:          _requestTokens(),

30:              'nothing run',
31:        );
32:        return true;
33:      }
34:      final merged = mode == CompactionMode.merged;
35:      final adapter = _StructuredHooksAdapter(hooks);
36:      final outcome = await _runStructured(
37:        adapter: adapter,
38:        capTriggered: capTriggered,
39:        mode: mode,
40:      );
41:      // gh-1742 invariant 1: a FORCED run (observed usage over the line)
42:      // that did zero passes is not relief — the structured engine's
43:      // pass loops gate on its own transcript estimate, so an
44:      // observation the estimate cannot see would come back `ok` with
45:      // nothing done and the child would ride an over-window context
46:      // into the next request. Fall through to the classic engine,
47:      // whose forced semantics run the summarizer regardless of its
48:      // own estimate. An unforced no-op stays the success short-circuit.
49:      // GOAL #2394 (AC4): the merged hand-over has no residual classic
50:      // fallback — its zero-pass run is a valid "nothing to dispose"
51:      // verdict, never a reason to start another engine.
52:      if (outcome.ok &&
53:          (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))) {
54:        // Close the hooks bracket the classic [AutoCompactor.run] closes
55:        // on every terminal path: hosts key off [AutoCompactorHooks.onDone]
56:        // (the CLI's HEP `compaction_end` frame, the Flutter chat sheet),
57:        // so a structured run that skips it leaves them open forever.
58:        // gh-2237: the engine's zero-pass exit reason rides along — the
59:        // host renders the no-op terminal receipt from it.
60:        hooks.onDone(
61:          adapter.passCount,
62:          _requestTokens(),
63:          reason: outcome.reason,
64:        );
65:        return true;
66:      }
67:      if (merged) {
68:        // GOAL #2394 (AC4/I9) — NO fallback: a failed merged call reports
69:        // loudly and the run is a failure; the classic prefix compactor
70:        // and the judge ladder are never reached from the merged path.
71:        if (outcome.timedOut) {

81:              ),
82:        );
83:      }

87:        // do NOT abort the live session — re-running the classic engine

91:        // marker) so the run proceeds. The failure verdict is kept only

107:            tokensBefore: _requestTokens(),

109:            fallback: null,
110:            ok: false,
111:            error: outcome.error,

113:        );

116:      }

118:      // fallback of the STANDALONE ladder (issue #148 flowchart S7/D4;

+import '../compaction/record_tag.dart' show TranscriptSeqMap;
+import '../compaction/request_snapshot.dart' show RequestSnapshotStore;
+
+  /// GOAL #2394: the tag epoch of the current transcript — the record
+  /// alias every `state.messages` entry projects from (`null` = no tags:
+  /// a classic-engine host, or a transcript not built from the session
+  /// projection). Set by [refreshAgentState] / the host alongside
+  /// `messages`; the loop stamps request COPIES from it, never the
+  /// transcript.
+  TranscriptSeqMap? recordSeqs;
+  /// GOAL #2394 (AC2): the session's request snapshots (S0) — the last
+  /// main send as sent, overwritten at every send seam and read by the
+  /// compaction host for the cache-affine hand-over call. Hosts
+  /// invalidate it on branch switch / checkpoint restore and after a
+  /// successful compaction run.
+  final RequestSnapshotStore requestSnapshots = RequestSnapshotStore();
+
+  /// GOAL #2394 (AC8, E37): whether main requests carry the `m<seq>`
+  /// record tags — only under the structured compaction engine. OFF by
+  /// default: a host opts in when it resolves the structured engine (the
+  /// CLI and the Flutter app sync it from their engine setting); a
+  /// classic-engine host keeps the pre-#2394 wire byte-identically — no
+  /// tags, no merged hand-over, one cache invalidation at the switch.
+  bool recordTagsEnabled = false;
+
+  /// Drops the current request snapshot — hosts call it when the
+  /// projection it described is gone (branch switch, checkpoint restore,
+  /// a successful compaction run).
+  void invalidateRequestSnapshot(String reason) =>
+      requestSnapshots.invalidate(reason);
+
+      recordSeqs: recordTagsEnabled ? _state.recordSeqs : null,
+      requestSnapshots: requestSnapshots,

# PR #2407 rework — owned CI reds fixed (gh-2394)

## Issues/Notes

- **No open review threads** — `review_state.md` reports 0 open threads and
  `pr_discussions_raw.json` is `{"threads": []}`, so this lap carries no
  thread replies; `outputs/review_replies.json` contains `{ "replies": [] }`.

  contexts whose logs 404 (`Quality gate`, `JS engine integration
  (quickjs-ng)`, `Binaries smoke gate`, completed within 1 s at 23:24:33) are
  the SM-validation stamps: their check-run output is literally
  `SM validation: failure — Dispatched run 45505208765`, mirroring that run's
  three failed jobs. Fixing the two root causes greens all six.
- The branch carries the rework commits `956f1c0fbd` (CRAP refactor) and
  `e853789ba8` (sendText gate fix) plus this lap's regression test
  (`7193fd8d7e`) and a transient-debug-artifact cleanup (`2bdab1a847`); both
  fixes were independently re-derived, then RED/GREEN-verified locally here.
- Local-only gate noise, not CI-relevant: `crap4dart check --baseline`'s

  gitignored, absent from CI checkouts); `dart analyze` errors confined to
  `office_addin/dart` vanish once that nested package gets its own `pub get`.
  CI's Static gates leg is green on the fix commit.

## Owned CI violations (all `owned`, `confirmedBy: none` — none disputed)

| check | root cause | status |
|---|---|---|
| `CRAP + duplication` (exit 2) | `AutoCompactorFactory.run` CRAP **14.00 > 12.0** (CC 14 @ 97.3 % cov, `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart:1234`) | **fixed** — `956f1c0fbd` |
| `Flutter app tests (shard 1/2)` | `flutter_app/test/integration/chat_app_creation_test.dart:158` — manifest read `null`; run never started | **fixed** — `e853789ba8` |
| `Quality gate` (aggregate, guards + flutter-tests legs) | mirrors the two rows above | **fixed** — same commits |
| `Quality gate` (SM stamp) | mirror of dispatched run 45505208765 | **fixed** — greens with the run |
| `JS engine integration (quickjs-ng)` (SM stamp) | mirror of dispatched run 45505208765 | **fixed** — greens with the run |
| `Binaries smoke gate` (SM stamp) | mirror of dispatched run 45505208765 | **fixed** — greens with the run |

## Approach

1. **CRAP ratchet (`CRAP + duplication` → `guards` leg).** crap4dart 0.15.0
   scores `CRAP = CC²·(1−cov)³ + CC`, so CRAP ≥ CC and a CC-14 method cannot
   pass a 12.0 threshold at any coverage. The PR's merged-mode additions gave
   `AutoCompactorFactory.run` 13 decision points (mode-table `&&`, the soft
   trigger `if &&`, the `merged ||` relief arm, the merged no-fallback block,
   the standalone budget-kill block). The fix is a behavior-neutral
   decomposition that keeps every contract comment with its code:
   `_runStructuredEngine` (returns `null` only for the standalone residual
   classic fallback, so the cancel-parity checks stay in `run`), with
   `_zeroPassIsRelief`, `_finishMerged`, `_standaloneTimedOut` carrying the
   verdict branches. Post-refactor CC: `run` ≤ 7, `_runStructuredEngine` 8,
   helpers 2–4 — verified locally with a crap4dart census over the refactored
   file.
2. **Flutter integration test (`flutter-tests` leg).** `AgentService.sendText`
   awaited `handOverTrigger.gate.wait()` unconditionally; even an idle gate
   costs one microtask, so the documented host pattern
   `unawaited(sendText(...)); await waitForIdle()` observed the agent idle
   *before* the run had started — the scripted write-tool turn never landed
   and the manifest read came back `null` (reproduced locally on the branch
   and confirmed passing on `origin/main` in a clean worktree). The fix
   awaits the gate only while a compaction is actually in flight
   (`if (gate.isCompacting)`), restoring the synchronous run start.
3. **TDD.** The existing integration test is the RED repro (fails on
   `471dbff2`, passes on `main` and on the fix). A focused regression test
